name: HandsVision
summary:
HandsVision is a rock-paper-scissors game based on mixed reality. Anyone can enjoy it, regardless of gender or age, and the winner can advance their character.
- As you overcome numerous levels, a new rock-paper-scissors game opens.
- If you cannot solve the problem, use a special item to solve the problem.
- Achieve goals and solve countless levels.
- New levels are added every week, providing unstoppable fun.
- Some of the game items require paid payment. Please check the privacy policy at  http://www.big
